newsitem.title: UK: BAA shares fall after windfall tax report.
newsitem.headline: BAA shares fall after windfall tax report.

text.p: Shares in British airport operator BAA Plc fell on Friday on reports that a windfall tax planned by the opposition Labour Party would apply to the company, dealers said.
The shares were 12-1/2p weaker at 532-1/2 by 0952 GMT.
The Financial Times newpaper said that Labour's proposed windfall tax would apply to a wider range of companies than previously thought, including BAA, Associated British Ports and Railtrack.
Associated British Ports shares fell eight pence to 306-1/2 and Railtrack was down 3-1/2p at 382-1/2.

"Most of the utilities have already factored in the windfall tax but some of these marginal ones have been hit because people weren't sure whether or not they would have to pay," one market-maker said.
